'''''Star Wars 3-D''''' is a three-issue [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Len Wein]] and [[John Stephenson]]. It was published by [[Blackthorne Publishing]] as a part of the [[Wikipedia:Blackthorne Publishing#Blackthorne 3-D Series|''Blackthorne 3-D Series'']] from [[1987]] to [[1988]].

Originally four more issues were planned for [[1989]], but were never released. According to a listing in ''[[Wikipedia:Amazing Heroes|Amazing Heroes]]'', the issues would have been written by Len Wein and John Stephenson, illustrated by [[Lorenzo Lizana]] and edited by [[Lucy Autrey Wilson]], and set between the films ''[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]'' and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. [[Star Wars 3-D 4|''Star Wars 3-D'' 4]] would have told "[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]'s version of how he "acquired the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millenium Falcon]]'' from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]" and [[Star Wars 3-D 5|the following issue]] would have followed [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] "on a search for the missing Solo".<ref name="Amazing Heroes 157">{{BookCite|container=Star Wars in 3-D|title=[[Wikipedia:Amazing Heroes|Amazing Heroes]]|contributor=[[Wikipedia:Kim Thompson|Kim Thompson]] {{C|editor}}|pages=pp. 209-210|publisher=[[Wikipedia:Fantagraphics Books|Fantagraphics Books]]|date=1989-01-15|number=#157}}</ref>
After experiencing huge financial losses in 1989, Blackthorne Publishing closed [[1990|the following year]].
